description:
5 Game ready grenades set. 

Just some battered grenades for fps shooters, or other projects. Write your suggestions in comments. 

* **RGD-5** (6166 Tris) – 1954 Soviet offensive fragmentation grenade. 
* **F1** (7134 Tris) – 1940 Soviet defensive fragmentation grenade. 
* **M84 **(7882 Tris) – 1955 U.S. stun/flashbang grenade. 
* **M18 **(4900 Tris) – 1942 U.S. colored smoke grenade. 
* **AN-M14** (4900 Tris) – 1943 U.S. thermite incendiary grenade.
